recentItems.title: Zwa Maramani | Deforestation
recentItems.description:
Ha Makuya, Tshenzhelani na manwe mashango a nga tsini huna thaidzo khulwane, ya u remiwa ha miri ya Mipani duvha na duvha hu tshi itelwa khuni dza u rengisa.

Vhanwe vhadzulapo vho tangana misanda vha kho lingedza nga ndila dzothe u thivhela zwiito izwi. Fhedzi hunga nndwa ine vha kho ilwa I kho Konda, ngeno muvhuso u swika zwino hu sina zwine wa khou thusa ngazwo.

In Makuya, Tshenzhelani and surrounding villages, residents are facing a growing environmental crisis as mopane trees continue to be cut down daily for the commercial firewood trade.

Concerned community members have organized patrol groups and are doing everything they can to curb the destruction. However, they say the fight is becoming more difficult, with little to no support from government authorities to date.
